expectations.text: The rewritten notice describes the behaviour in neutral wording with a date and a named space
expectations.evidence: The primary rewrite names the space ("in #reviews") and is neutral in tone ("Someone flagged a concern about how your exchange with Priya went" — no verdict, no characterization), and the fallback variant repeats the same framing ("we got a complaint about your exchange with Priya in #reviews on Thursday"). But two of the three required elements fall short. (1) No date: "on Thursday" is a bare weekday reference with no calendar date, so the notice is not anchored to a specific, unambiguous occasion.
